1.

What shall it be, O beloved Lord, With Thee to reign, with Thee to dwell, When in Thy love already here We find such sweet repose. What comfort that word contains: “Ye shall be where I am.”

2.

When nevermore our gaze grows dim And flesh no longer rises up, When ended is the long night And we, O Christ, behold Thee, Then free from earth’s constraint, We shall praise Thee with a better song.

3.

Thou shalt come: what sweet hope! Ah, soon we go to meet Thee, Soon ended is our pilgrimage And we shall have eternal rest. Glorified, we shall see Thee face to face.
